scope: One final batch of 24 synthetic real DeepSeek conversations through isolated DSH profiles and the exact installed candidate: 10 regression, 3 natural capture, 7 scripted-approval and 4 additional normal-chat cases. No direct business API calls or fixture LLM. Scoped functional and known major answer-regression checks passed; this is not a universal answer-quality guarantee.

nonblockingObservations: One answer says cha-bu-dao with the wrong Chinese character; several answers still expose unnecessary status labels. These cosmetic model variations are not guarantees of flawless copy.

limitations: Prior failing candidates are retained, not silently replaced.
Model behavior remains stochastic; finite passing cases do not prove all future responses.
Scripted approvals do not substitute for human UI acceptance.
Real health data, OCR completeness, other platforms and unrestricted general-tool compositions remain unqualified.
